assumptions.NONHOME_POWER_V1: Existing rating weights and average/rated fractions are development assumptions conditional on the known charger type.
assumptions.POWER_TEST_PAIRING_V1: Each owner/context/draw uses the same random stream across power cases. Home draws and selected non-home ratings are matched.
assumptions.DRAW_INTERPRETATION_V1: These are sampler checks, not sessions. Future home equipment power is retained per owner realisation; non-home equipment/power is sampled per session.

limits: Mixed types retain their raw answers; no charger subset or usage proportion is inferred. Unknown types are not imputed.
Open-upper and missing home power remain deferred; non-home ratings never fill home-power gaps.
Unknown equipment detail is not automatically a type contradiction.
Availability of power components is not full owner readiness or approval of energy, timing or scheduling models.
Deferral reasons identify the first blocking power rule per context; retained source fields can contain additional unresolved quantities.
Vehicle acceptance limits, connectors, battery compatibility and the electrical energy boundary remain unresolved.
Rating factors are not conversion efficiency; no losses, SOC taper, station sharing, queues or extra TOU delay are added.
No station-inventory probabilities, fleet shares or district/place allocation are estimated.
Paired copies and repeated draws are not independent owners or observations.
electrical_boundary: Constant-power test proxy; meter-versus-battery interpretation remains unresolved.
